lines.trans: Fedya, when will the sea bream finally be ready?
The receipt was punched only now, I am rushing!
Guests at the table ate all the bread!
And what can I do right now?
Waiters have been waiting for hot fish for forty minutes!
We have a regular fishermen convention today!
Fedya, calm down and hand over urgent orders!
I am doing everything possible, do not yell.
Wait, what is this terrible stench?
Oh no, the quails on the stove burnt!
What a nightmare, complete smoke in the kitchen!
Urgently take the pan off the hot fire!
The new shift began with pure disaster.

present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: сделать всё возможное = do everything possible

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)

examples.trans: When will the sea bream finally be ready?
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: This is simply a catastrophe for us!
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: colloquial: Это кошмар! = That's awful / a nightmare!

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

начаться.gloss: to begin, to start, to break out

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to break out (intransitive)

examples.trans: The film started at seven sharp.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: to hand over, give back, yield

examples.trans: The quails on the stove burnt!

meanings.note: large flat stone or concrete block

сгореть.gloss: to burn down, to burn up

снимать.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent
